name: game-platform
description: Bun monorepo for a web platform hosting 16 independent mini-games.

scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,games -c blue,magenta "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:games"
scripts.dev:games: concurrently -k -n 01,02,03,04,05,06,07,08,09,10,11,12,13,14,15,16 "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-01 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-02 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-03 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-04 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-05 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-06 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-07 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-08 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-09 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-10 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-11 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-12 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-13 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-14 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-15 dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-16 dev"
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -k -n types,config,sdk,ui -c yellow,cyan,magenta,blue "bun run --filter @game-platform/types dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/config dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/game-sdk dev" "bun run --filter @game-platform/ui dev"
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter './apps/*' build
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter @game-platform/types build && bun run --filter @game-platform/config build && bun run --filter @game-platform/game-sdk build && bun run --filter @game-platform/ui build
scripts.test: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.test:games: bun run --filter './apps/game-*' test && bun run --filter @game-platform/game-01 test && bun run --filter @game-platform/game-02 test && bun run --filter @game-platform/game-03 test && bun run --filter @game-platform/game-04 test && bun run --filter @game-platform/game-05 test && bun run --filter @game-platform/game-06 test
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
